module_summary: Two-stage pipelined 4-bit shift-and-add multiplier: generate block forms partial products, stage 1 registers pairwise sums, stage 2 registers final product.

anchors.name: mul_a
anchors.why: Multiplicand, zero-extended and shifted to form partial products.

anchors.name: mul_b
anchors.why: Multiplier; each bit gates a shifted partial product.

anchors.name: mul_result
anchors.why: Array of partial products, mul_a shifted by i when mul_b[i].

anchors.name: sum_tmp1
anchors.why: Stage-1 register: sum of partial products 0 and 1.

anchors.name: sum_tmp2
anchors.why: Stage-1 register: sum of partial products 2 and 3.

anchors.name: mul_out
anchors.why: Stage-2 registered product, sum of stage-1 registers.

groups.name: Partial product generation
groups.description: Shifted multiplicand gated by multiplier bits.

groups.name: Stage 2 final add
groups.description: Adds stage-1 sums into registered product.
